purpose: Predict a product's sales for the next 7 days from its own sales history, as advice for the seller.
method: Poisson regression (alpha 0.1) on weekday, payday week (25th-3rd) and trend; fitted per product on request; needs at least 28 days of history.
evaluation_data: SYNTHETIC: 40 made-up products x 20 weeks with known weekday, payday, trend and Poisson noise. Not real sales.
backtest: Rolling origin over the last 6 weeks of each product; MAE in units per day.
human_in_the_loop: Advice only: the seller decides stock and prices (spec BR-14 forbids automated stock or pricing decisions).
limits: Synthetic evaluation shows the method can learn such patterns, not that real Kuruman sales follow them. Holidays, weather and events are not modelled. New products have no forecast for 4 weeks.
